content_sections.heading: Reservation Policy
content_sections.text: Reservation for SC/ST/OBC/PWD/EWS shall apply at C-DAC as per Government of India norms. Candidates belonging to reserved categories must produce, if called for certificate verification, the original certificate issued by the competent authority in the format prescribed by DoPT, Government of India; otherwise they will not be permitted to join the selection process or claim reservation benefits. OBC candidates must produce a certificate in the Government of India prescribed format specifically stating that they do not belong to the “creamy layer”. OBC candidates belonging to the creamy layer are not eligible for OBC concession and must indicate their category as “General/Unreserved”. PWD category candidates must submit a disability certificate in the format prescribed by DoPT OM No. 36035/3/2004-Estt.(Res) dated 29.12.2005 (as amended). Only candidates with 40% or more disability are eligible for reservation under the PWD category. EWS category candidates must submit an Income and Asset Certificate issued by the competent authority in the format prescribed in Annexure-I of DoPT OM No. 36039/1/2019-Estt.(Res) dated 31.01.2019 (as amended).

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for C-DAC Chennai Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Register your candidature by filling the Google Form: https://forms.gle/TSX7P5BMPy6abJCK6 . Download and fill the Application Form (and the One-page Write-up, for experienced posts), and affix a recent passport-size photograph. Carry the duly filled application form, the one-page write-up (6 sets, for experienced posts only), and all required documents to the interview venue on the scheduled date and time. Only registered candidates reporting at the venue during the specified reporting time (09:30 AM – 10:30 AM) will be allowed to attend the interview. All queries pertaining to recruitment, including the selection process, should be addressed only to the recruitment team via email at [email protected] .

content_sections.heading: Documents Required
content_sections.text: Candidates must bring the original certificates and one set of self-attested photocopies of the following documents/certificates to the interview venue: Duly filled application form 6 sets of one-page write-up (for experienced posts only) A valid photo ID card with date of birth 10th, 12th, and BE/B.Tech/MCA/M.Sc/ME/M.Tech certificates and consolidated marksheet, as applicable Experience certificate(s) for the period claimed in the application, from the first to the last organisation Document proof of current employment; No Objection Certificate from the current employer (applicable for candidates working in Central/State Government/Public Sector Undertakings/Government autonomous bodies) Caste certificate for SC/ST candidates, and Non-Creamy Layer certificate for OBC candidates Medical certificate (in case of PWD) Income and Asset Certificate (in case of EWS) Relevant documents as per notification, for any other categories claiming reservation/concession Candidates who fail to produce any of the required documents will be liable to have their candidature/appointment, as the case may be, cancelled/terminated.

faq.question: Q1. What is C-DAC Chennai Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It is a recruitment notification by the Centre for Development of Advanced Computing, Chennai, to fill 59 Project Staff posts on a contract basis across Project Associate, Project Engineer, Senior Project Engineer, and Project Manager categories.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in C-DAC Chennai Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 59 vacancies in total - 14 Project Associate, 27 Project Engineer, 10 Senior Project Engineer, and 8 Project Manager posts.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to register for C-DAC Chennai Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date of registration is 22nd September 2026, till 17:00 hrs.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification required for C-DAC Chennai Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Requirements vary by post - a B.E/B.Tech is required for Project Associate and Project Engineer, a B.E/B.Tech or MCA with 60% or equivalent CGPA for Senior Project Engineer, and a B.E/B.Tech/M.E/M.Tech/MCA/M.Sc/PhD with 60% or equivalent CGPA for Project Manager, in relevant specialisations.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for C-DAC Chennai Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The upper age limit ranges from 30 years (Project Associate) to 56 years (Project Manager), depending on the post, with relaxation as per rules.

faq.question: Q6. How can I apply for C-DAC Chennai Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates must register via the Google Form link provided, then bring the completed application form and required documents to the walk-in/online interview.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary for C-DAC Chennai Project Staff posts?
faq.answer: The consolidated monthly salary ranges from ₹34,000 for Project Associate to ₹90,000 for Project Manager, depending on the post and experience.

faq.question: Q8. What is the mode of interview for C-DAC Chennai Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: All four posts are listed with Walk-in as the mode of interview.
